description: Defines the TimesheetRow class for managing timesheet entries, including project association, activity, date handling, and timesheet item assignment within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TimesheetRow
classes.description: Represents a row in a timesheet, associating a project, activity, and dates with timesheet items, and managing total hours.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TimesheetRow with a project, activity, and dates.

methods.name: setDates
methods.description: Formats and sets the dates for the timesheet row.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total hours by a specified amount.

methods.name: assignTimesheetItem
methods.description: Assigns a TimesheetItem to a date, throws exception if already assigned.
